rationale: A defensible continuous upgrade of the archive's binary cash-validation gate (signed z-score creates a real short leg and industry-neutralizes both legs), though the coalesce-to-zero R&D rank still parks many non-R&D firms near a neutral signal value and dilutes the spread.

This uses the identical two components as the archived Soft-Collateral Maturity Gap with only RANK→IND_RANK/IND_ZSCORE substitutions, making it largely a cosmetic variant; worse, it silently inverts the long leg so that intangible-heavy net-cash firms become the most extreme positions, a change in economics that the hypothesis text never acknowledges.

Replacing coverage volatility with a two-period downside floor is a substantively different construct (level-based persistence rather than dispersion) and directly addresses why the archived volatility version produced a strong slope but no alpha, though it overlaps considerably with the existing liquidity-level interaction.

target_name: Organic Knowledge Over Goodwill Under Debt
rationale: The organic-R&D-versus-acquired-goodwill contrast is a genuinely different intangible-composition channel than anything in the archive and the liability-pressure scaler is coherent, but the difference of two zero-inflated coalesced ranks means much of the cross-sectional variation is driven by reporting presence rather than economic intensity.

The hypothesis and reasoning are internally inconsistent (the reasoning claims the signal identifies "accounting distress" at high values and "genuine fragility" at low values, i.e. bad news at both ends, which cannot support a monotone positive slope), and the wcap/at minus ceq/at rank gap is mostly a mechanical asset-maturity/leverage composition proxy rather than the stated liquidity-versus-book-solvency disagreement.

The triple product is dominated by the gross-margin z-score (a close cousin of the published gross-profitability anomaly) merely magnitude-weighted by two positive ranks, and within-industry gross margin is mechanically increasing in xrd/sale since R&D sits outside cogs, so the "interaction" partly re-multiplies R&D intensity by itself.
